|-- REVIEW => ChangeSessionPreview [D]

|   |   `-- => diffChangeDocument()
|   `-- main thread: changePreviewText() -> render / fold / connections
|-- READY => update(status=ready)
|   `-- => validateReady() [A]
`-- ACCEPT => accept() [A]
    |-- 1 replay receipt / check version and ready
    |-- 2 validate changes; reject stale live originals
    |-- 3 => projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges()
    `-- 4 => finishAcceptance(): freeze proposal
